scope: Final physical IC-pin component, number and name. Missing outputs count as incorrect. Coordinates locate rows only; no net or contest score reported.

baseline.method: Stage1 and output components matched by geometry, no label text in inference. Final outputs paired one-to-one with reviewed physical pin rows on the same box side by orthogonal row distance; tolerance 0.45 smallest adjacent true-pin pitch. It is only row association, not terminal coordinate scoring. Missing output is wrong. Number/name scores condition on physical box, ignore component output identity; all_three also requires exact component key. False outputs outside reviewed physical rows are listed separately.
baseline.limits: 0076 and 0080 already took part in prior independent OCR diagnostics; 0097 and 0099 are newly picked outside cases 1-50 and known 10GT group exclusions. Heuristic image/text grouping cannot guarantee no circuit overlap. Old OCR checkpoint training manifest is absent. This is not a certified held-out model-unseen benchmark. Labels are assistant-reviewed, human_verified=false. Only 5 selected IC boxes are fully reviewed; no full-image false-positive rate is claimed.
